title: From Bitcoin to Anthropic: How PrimeXBT Is Expanding Crypto Futures Beyond Coins
summary: Perpetual futures have traditionally been associated with cryptocurrencies, and they’ve grown into a substantial market. According to CoinGecko Research figures cited by Forbes, crypto perpetuals average approximately $4.7 trillion in monthly trading volume.
